scope: Independent final refinement and retained chemistry check of actual completed provisional flank model; no MD, no native-loop accuracy claim.

verification.flank_displacement_baseline: Saved coordinates entering refinement, after recorded sidechain sampling.

expanded_geometry.method: Gross nonperiodic heavy-atom geometry screen for all modeled loop residues; not a native-loop, rotamer, Ramachandran or energy validation.

criteria.other_heavy_bonds: 0.70–1.25 times summed elemental covalent radii (C/N/O/S/P); generous gross bounds, not equilibrium lengths
criteria.contact_exclusions: self, directly bonded and 1–3 atom pairs; hydrogen contacts excluded
